description.value:
Flames burst from the ground around you, forming a ring 15 feet in radius and 10 feet tall. A creature that starts its turn within the ring or passes through it during its turn takes 1d6 fire damage. A creature inside the ring who tries to push through the flames to leave must first succeed on a Wisdom saving throw, though anything immune to fear or fire passes automatically.

Overcharge Tech. Cast with a tech slot of 2nd level or higher, the fire damage increases by 1d6 for each slot level beyond 1st.

system.source: PHB Ch.14 Casting — Tech Powers, Level 1
